Docs.summary: Represents a single measurement from a Downlink Time Difference of Arrival (DL-TDoA) ranging session.
Returns a list of active ranging round indexes.
Docs.value: The list of active ranging round indexes. An empty list is returned if active ranging round indexes are not present.

Docs.summary: Returns the Clock Frequency Offset (CFO) of a Responder DT-Anchor.
Docs.value: The Anchor CFO as a float, or Float.NaN if not available.

Docs.summary: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) azimuth in degrees.
Docs.value: The AoA azimuth value in degrees, or Float.NaN if not available.

Docs.summary: Returns the Figure of Merit (FoM) of the AoA azimuth.
Docs.value: The AoA azimuth FoM value in percentage, or 0 if not available.

Docs.summary: Returns the Angle of Arrival (AoA) elevation in degrees.
Docs.value: The AoA elevation value in degrees, or Float.NaN if not available.

Docs.summary: Returns the Figure of Merit (FoM) of the AoA elevation.
Docs.value: The AoA elevation FoM value in percentage, or 0 if not available.

Docs.summary: Returns the block index of the current ranging block.
Docs.value: The block index as an integer.

Docs.summary: Returns the locally measured Clock Frequency Offset (CFO) by the DT-Tag.
Docs.value: The CFO as a float, or Float.NaN if not supported.
